work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. XV at 42514, synopsis/summary through 42557, and the actual Innocentius protocol at 42559–42560 identify the outer secretaries act. Its proem and all twenty-four clauses run through 43578, followed by conventional closing at 43580–43582, dating at 43584–43588, subscriptions at 43593–43663 and editorial dating at 43664, before XVI at 43667. Callistus III and Pius II at 42575–42591 are narrative predecessors. Martin V's regulation is deliberately introduced and quoted within clause 15 at 43014–43067; the outer act resumes at 43068 and the quotation remains integral, not split. The differing raw secretary counts are preserved; the source itself describes reduction after deaths at 43315–43323. Literal conventional etc. at 42686 and the closing is retained without expansion. No displaced historical note or explicit missing substantive portion was found. The frozen empty date_raw is preserved despite the printed closing date.
